# FG-INT-0009

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 500 |
| 重大度 | warn |
| Runbook | [`integration-feed-lag`](../../ops/runbooks/integration-feed-lag.md) |
| 発生させるテスト | `feed_lag_names_not_reading_and_behind_integrations` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: 連携先がイベントの履歴を読みに来ていないか、大きく遅れています。管理者に連絡してください。
- en: An integration has not read its event feed for long, or is far behind. Contact the administrator.
- id: Sebuah integrasi sudah lama tidak membaca feed perubahannya, atau sangat tertinggal. Hubungi administrator.

## 原因 (cause)

An enabled integration with bound projects has not read its feed for 24 hours (`reason=not_reading`; one that never read counts 24 hours after its first binding), or the oldest event it has not read yet is older than half the retention period (`reason=behind`): when retention deletes it, the consumer gets 410 retention and has to resync (ADR-0016 §11, plan 02 §11.3). Raised by forge doctor (`integrations.feed_lag`) from forge.integration_feed_reads, and logged at warn by the feed itself when a read finds the consumer behind (at most once per minute per integration, with the read's request_id). No request fails with it.

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

The doctor line or the log event carries `reason`, `integration_id`, `last_read_at` (RFC 3339, UTC, or `never`), `behind_seconds` (behind) and `retention_days`. SELECT integration_id, last_read_at, cursor_seq, read_bound_seq, oldest_unread_at FROM forge.integration_feed_reads ORDER BY last_read_at; kanflow's own logs show whether its poller runs.

## 対処 (fix)

Follow runbook integration-feed-lag: check that kanflow's poller runs and authenticates (the service account's token: runbook service-accounts), that the work-item-sync subscriber is not stuck (doctor subscribers.work-item-sync; it bounds what the feed returns), then let the consumer catch up. A consumer that cannot catch up before retention resyncs after its 410.
